verdict.rationale: Svelte's core design is a compiler that emits minimal, dependency-light JS rather than shipping a runtime framework, directly reducing bundle size and surface area (svelte-docs-1, svelte-gh-1, svelte-docs-4). Independent corroboration exists via a community report of improved bundle size after migrating from React (svelte-comm-8). Missing for 10: concrete bundle-size benchmarks/numbers, explicit discussion of supply-chain risk reduction (e.g., dependency count/audit data).
